mapper.select: select (select count(*) from biz_asset_info where del_flag = '0') as assetTotal, (select count(*) from biz_repair_order where del_flag = '0' and status = '0') as pendingRepairs, (select count(*) from biz_asset_info where del_flag = '0' and status = '2') as repairingAssets, (select count(*) from biz_asset_info where del_flag = '0' and date(create_time) = curdate()) as todayAssets
select status, count(*) as cnt from biz_asset_info where del_flag = '0' group by status

select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as repairDate, count(*) as cnt from biz_repair_order where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by repairDate

select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as repairDate, count(*) as cnt from biz_repair_order where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 29 day) group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by repairDate
select category, count(*) as cnt from biz_asset_info where del_flag = '0' group by category
select status, count(*) as cnt from biz_asset_use where del_flag = '0' group by status
select ifnull(sum(price), 0) as assetValueTotal, count(*) as assetCount from biz_asset_info where del_flag = '0'
select consumable_name as consumableName, spec, unit, stock_qty as stockQty, warn_qty as warnQty from biz_consumable where del_flag = '0' and stock_qty <= warn_qty order by stock_qty
